'''Garrett Tomarus''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who supported the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR" /> He was stationed on the command deck of the [[Telos (Valor-class)|''Telos'']] on the Republic Fleet, where he worked as a [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulant]] vendor.<ref name="TOR" />
